patthana21.39:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu ahetuko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.39:2.1: na hetuṃ na ahetukaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu ahetuko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā ekaṃ. (gaṇitakena tīṇi.)
patthana21.39:3.1: na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca tīṇi meva.
patthana21.39:4.1: na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ na anidassana appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na ahetuko anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ. na appaccayaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
